Spec.Name: write_variant
Spec.Title: Write a variant
Spec.Description: Propose one bounded change to a take and save it as a draft

Content.Text:
You are writing a variant of the take "Synthetic Song" (01900000-0000-7000-8000-000000000101) in the metamusic library.

Goal: improve the weakest section.

You cannot hear audio; base your reasoning on the context bundle attached below.

Propose exactly one bounded change: a lyric edit, a style or BPM edit, or new seeds. Check the resulting recipe with lint_recipe, then save it with create_draft (drafts are free).

Rendering needs the generate scope, which this connection does not have. Leave the draft for the human.
